latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the openclaw-self-improving-agent skill.
- Provides structured logging for learnings, errors, and feature requests to support continuous self-improvement.
- Includes quick reference guide for when and how to log different types of events.
- Supports both OpenClaw integration (recommended) and generic setup for other agents.
- Offers markdown-based templates and guidelines for logging, tracking, and promoting learnings to project memory.
- Details setup steps, workspace structure, and mechanisms for sharing learnings across sessions.
